docs.title: About Me
docs.text:
I'm a senior technical writer and UX writing specialist with 25+ years of experience in enterprise software, with deep expertise in healthcare technology. I've worked as a sole contributor owning complete documentation strategies across multiple products in complex, HIPAA-regulated environments, and as a collaborator on cross-functional product teams.

I ask the right questions to surface the full story, align stakeholders, and ensure everyone's on the same page.

docs.title: Experience
docs.text:
NantHealth — Lead Content Writer (2021–2026) Sole writer responsible for all content across two B2B SaaS products — NaviNet and Eviti. Authored and published end-user help, admin guides, and configuration documentation in Oxygen XML. Designed in-app guides in Pendo to reduce support volume and boost feature adoption. Led cross-platform email redesign initiative across Salesforce, HubSpot, and the core product. Analyzed content for an AI chatbot initiative and collaborated with development on synonym mapping.

NantHealth — Senior Technical Writer (2013–2021) Developed API getting started and companion guides to support NaviNet API sales and implementation. Led full content migration from Drupal and Confluence to DITA/XML. Designed EDI X12 transaction mapping tables across multiple transaction sets. Created detailed configuration guides using Postman to call live client APIs and inspect health plan-specific JSON configurations.

GE Healthcare (formerly IDX Systems) — Lead Design Engineer / Technical Writer (1994–2012) Owned complete documentation sets for multiple complex integrated applications. Designed software solutions and served as project lead for web services integration. Participated in ICD-10 compliance project and presented at regional users' conference.

docs.title: Eviti Connect Help Center
docs.text:
NantHealth | Web-based help system

View the Eviti Connect Help Center

Eviti Connect is an oncology clinical decision support platform used by providers and payers nationwide. As sole writer, I developed and maintained the complete help center for this product, including task-based content for two distinct user audiences — oncology providers submitting treatment plans, and payers reviewing and processing them.

Highlights: - Dual-audience information architecture serving providers and payers - Task-based topics covering complex clinical and administrative workflows - Authored in DITA/XML using Oxygen XML Author - Published via Zoomin for Salesforce Help Center and web help outputs

Additional samples available upon request, including API documentation, UX writing, in-app guidance, and EDI transaction mapping guides.
